description: Adds a channel of trigger and gate output, placed immediately to the right of a Basic Sequencer, Binary Sequencer, Dual 8 Step Sequencer, 8 Step Trigger Sequencer or Gated Comparator

params.text: Turns the trigger on or off for that step; TRIG then goes high for as long as the sequencer's clock pulse is high
Turns the gate on or off for that step; GATE then stays high for the whole step, and two neighbouring steps turned on give one gate across both

outputs.text: Goes to 10V on any step whose trigger is turned on, for as long as the sequencer's clock pulse is high
Goes to 10V for the whole of any step whose gate is turned on; two neighbouring steps turned on give a single gate lasting across both

notes: the CHANNEL light shows which channel of the sequencer this module follows, in the colour of that channel's knobs; the direction, length and current step all come from that channel
more expanders can be chained by placing each one immediately to the right of the last, in any combination and any order; each expander in the chain adds one sample of delay
